meta.source: dragonheir.info, AllClash, HellHades, Reddit, Steam — community guides
meta.purpose: Community-recommended teams per activity. Baseline for comparison with custom analysis.

grave_of_venom.name: Grave of Venom
key_mechanics: Boss summons Wisps (adds) on attack
Skill 1: AoE + gives Shield to ALL adds. Each unbroken shield = boss +15% Damage Reduction
Skill 2: AoE + dispels 1 buff per hero
Skill 3: Single-target combo, targets random DPS if boss has <2 debuffs, targets tank if >=2 debuffs
Counter: Break add shields (each = 3% Max HP damage to boss), maintain 2+ debuffs on boss

community_teams.notes: Shook dispels shields after Skill 2. Frurbath Ult before boss Skill 3 for ATK Penalty.
Fire+Poison affinity. Brody shield-break utility.

key_heroes: Voresh (Buff Prohibition = adds never get shields)
critical_roles: 2+ debuffs on boss (redirect Skill 3 to tank)

grave_of_curse.name: Grave of Curse
key_mechanics: Passive Blood Gush: ALL HP damage drains Max HP permanently. Shields BLOCK the drain
Skill 1 Rage of Blood: Boss gains ATK Up + ACC Bonus. Devastating if not dispeled
Skill 2 Punishment: Steals 2 buffs, amplified if target <2 buffs
Skill 3 Vampiric Shield: AoE + Stun 5s if heroes <2 buffs + 20% recharge to boss
Counter: Buff Prohibition (prevent ATK Up), Shields (block Max HP drain), Debuff Immunity (block Stun)

community_teams.notes: Tamar Buff Prohibition prevents Rage of Blood. Felosia shields block Blood Gush. 3 Permafrost.
5 Permafrost. Thia = Debuff Immunity + Invisibility + Healing Prohibition. Lv17→Lv20 upgrade.

key_heroes: Felosia (shields MANDATORY — block Max HP drain + 30% DR + Control Immunity)
critical_roles: Shields (block Blood Gush Max HP drain)

grave_of_rot.name: Grave of Rot
key_mechanics: Skill 1: Healing Prohibition AoE — must cleanse immediately
Skill 2: Stun AoE — spread heroes to minimize targets
Skill 3: Big Hit — highest damage, need DMG Reduction before
Passive: Corrosion stacks — high stacks = one-shot. AoE healing clears stacks

community_teams.notes: Enna removes Healing Prohibition. Garius needs high RES for Stun. Shield before Skill 3.
Vicuc removes Healing Prohibition. Galyan needs high RES.

flame_domain.name: Flame Domain
key_mechanics: Avoid Fire/Poison heroes (take more damage, deal less)
Boss detonates HP burns
Debuff Immunity critical
Save ults for wave 3 (boss)

community_teams.notes: Catherine ult for Debuff Immunity before boss attacks. Lightning+Radiance comp.
Ice+Necrosis comp. Reserve ults for boss.
Summon + Acilia + Imortalidade. Lv14 apertado → Lv18 super fácil.

frost_domain.name: Frost Domain
key_mechanics: Passive: Boss gains shield when applying debuffs to your team
Buff Prohibition at intervals
Thorn Shield reflects damage
Multi-hit breaks thorn shield fast

community_teams.notes: Lydia Control Immunity. Catherine buffs prevent Buff Prohibition effects.
Shook removes boss shields. Enna clears debuffs.
Pure DPS race. 4 Dauntless + Acilia Debuff Immunity. ZERO healer/tank.

key_heroes: Catherine (Debuff Immunity = boss can't generate shields)

tempest_domain.name: Tempest Domain
key_mechanics: Boss summons baby dragons that HEAL the boss
Need AoE to kill adds fast
Healing Reduction helps
Counter: Lightning+Radiance heroes

community_teams.notes: Voresh + Sigrid kill baby dragons. Meggan buffs before boss Skill 1.
Thia buffer. Stack DPS on Voresh/Zhar'loth/Sigrid for dragons.
Summon Necrosis + Eches Healing Reduction. Lv16 blocked (boss regen too high).

critical_roles: AoE DPS (kill baby dragons ASAP — they heal boss)

fey_meander.name: Fey Meander (Fey Corridor)
key_mechanics: 3 boss types rotating: Lady of Pristine Decay, Lady of Greeneries, Fungal Spider Mother
Elemental Affinity (5 heroes same element) critical for high floors
Floor 180: debuff heroes need 270+ ACC, tanks 90k+ HP
Lady of Greeneries = #1 cause of wipe (Poison without Immunity = death)

community_teams.notes: Frurbath cleanses + heals. Manual ult timing on floor 160.
Catherine Debuff Immunity = CORE counter. Prevents Poison = boss damage minimal.
AoE Shield + ATK Penalty. Stack Resistance on primary healer.
Rally composition for Fey Meander.

critical_roles: Swap DPS for support on survival floors

fallen_shadow_spire.name: Fallen Shadow Spire
key_mechanics: Defend stronghold from monster waves
Kill enemies fast for consecutive-kill bonus
Score-based rewards
AoE dominant — clear waves efficiently
fallen_shadow_spire.note: Limited community guide data available. Tower defense mode favors AoE-heavy compositions.

grand_gladiator_arena.name: Grand Gladiator Arena
key_mechanics: Heroes synced to highest hero level = fairness
Defeat higher-ranked player = swap ranks
10 invitations/day
Top 10 defensive lineups visible

community_teams.notes: 5x heroes with 5.0 rating. Raw stats > mechanics in early game.
Dauntless burst comp. Acilia anti-debuff. Mid/late game dominant.

critical_roles: High individual hero ratings (5.0 stat advantage)
Burst damage (kill before enemy supports act)

realmwide_arena.name: Realmwide Arena (Team Arena)
key_mechanics: Build 3 teams
Best-of-3 system — counter-picking matters
Each lineup type has counters
Burst + Control dominate

community_teams.notes: Burst + control + poison. Hvitar 15% execute + Frost chain. Tamar 75% Buff Prohibition/Stun.

realmwide_arena.note: Limited specific guide data. Meta is Frost chain, Dauntless burst, or Poison chain.
